rationale: Identity: the held original (78 FR 39159, June 25, 2013) is Executive Order 13646, which establishes the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans. Section 6 reads 'Unless extended by the President, the Council shall terminate 2 years after the date of this order.' Every operative command depends on the Council: its membership (sec. 3), its functions (sec. 4), Treasury support for it (sec. 5) and the FACA functions (sec. 7(a)). Section 1 states a policy and contains no independent command. The held continuance orders 13652 and 13708 do not mention the Council, and no held text extends it. The Treasury notice FR Doc. 2015-13913 announces a June 17, 2015 meeting to vote on final recommendations, which fits a scheduled end. The U.S. Code note only prints the text. Provisional no (ended June 25, 2015) is supported.
